scope: Primary methodological sources; engineering margins are project design choices, not prescribed thresholds or exhaustive novelty search.

sources.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
sources.authors: Gavin C. Cawley; Nicola L. C. Talbot
sources.supports: Separating selection from performance evaluation; does not establish physical independence of CWRU.

sources.title: Nested versus non-nested cross-validation
sources.supports: Inner selection and outer evaluation; local grouping and retrospective limits are separate project decisions.

sources.title: Tuning the decision threshold for class prediction
sources.supports: Separate estimator fit from threshold tuning/evaluation; not a prescription for this P95 or engineering margins.

sources.title: Post-training integer quantization
sources.supports: Representative dataset and full integer conversion; train-only calibration is the project's evaluation rule.

sources.title: The Greedy Miser: Learning under Test-time Budgets
sources.authors: Zhixiang Xu; Kilian Weinberger; Olivier Chapelle
sources.supports: Feature acquisition/extraction and predictor execution both contribute to inference cost; selection by cost has prior work. No assertion that this project is the first cost-aware method.
